page.title: Missions
page.subtitle: Goals an AI orchestrator breaks into milestones, runs, judges and ships as one pull request.

empty.title: No missions yet
empty.description: Hand Forge a whole feature. The orchestrator plans milestones, runs each one, judges it against its acceptance criteria, and validates the result.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: The planner researches the goal and writes milestones with acceptance criteria.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: You review the milestones once. That is the only stop.

run.title: Run & judge
run.body: Workers execute each milestone; the judge accepts, retries or re-plans.

ship.title: Validate & ship
ship.body: The validator runs every verification on the branch, then it goes to Review as one PR.

stats.attemptsHint: Pauses for you after this many

banner.approve: Review the whole plan below: each milestone's tasks, contract and full spec. Once you approve, the mission runs on its own until it is ready for review.
banner.rateLimited: Rate limited ({{reason}}). Resuming {{step}} at {{time}}. Nothing is lost and no attempt is used.
banner.planning: The planner is researching the goal and writing milestones…
banner.review: Validated. The integration plan is in Review; create its pull request from there.

thread.title: Talk to the orchestrator
thread.placeholder: Suggest a change, ask why, or redirect the mission…
thread.waiting: Waiting for the orchestrator to read this

hint.approval: It answers now and revises the plan before you approve.
hint.running: Read at its next decision point (after the current step); it never interrupts a worker.
hint.review: For a small fix, use Quick change: the plan's chat makes it right in the worktree, keeping the mission in Review. Send here for a bigger change; it becomes a change request with its own milestones.
